Small cards in a careful copperplate, one at each place, each under its emblem:

Mr. Edmund Vale — Knowledge
Judge Cornelius Hawthorne — Law
Mr. Silas Blackwood — Industry
Dr. Julian Whitmore — Medicine
Mr. Reginald Ashcroft — Finance
The Rev. Thaddeus Bell — Faith
Mr. Anselm Mercer — Record

and, as guests of the house: Mrs. Lucille Vale, Mr. Walter Vale, Miss Beatrice Vale.

At the foot, laid and unused: W.
